scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']){if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.rmSync(f);}if(!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'')){console.error('Use pnpm instead');process.exit(1);}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.start: BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} PORT=${PORT:-5000} pnpm --filter @workspace/capstone run build && PORT=${PORT:-5000} pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
